segments.ja538:1.1: “Mā paṇḍiccayaṃ [paṇḍitiyaṃ (sī.), paṇḍicciyaṃ (pī.)] vibhāvaya, bālamato bhava sabbapāṇinaṃ;
segments.ja538:1.3: Sabbo taṃ jano ocināyatu, evaṃ tava attho bhavissati”.
segments.ja538:2.1: “Karomi te taṃ vacanaṃ, yaṃ maṃ bhaṇasi devate;
segments.ja538:3.3: Puṭṭho me samma akkhāhi, kiṃ kāsuyā karissasi”.
segments.ja538:4.1: “Rañño mūgo ca pakkho ca, putto jāto acetaso;
segments.ja538:4.3: Somhi raññā samajjhiṭṭho, puttaṃ me nikhaṇaṃ vane”.
segments.ja538:5.1: “Na badhiro na mūgosmi, na pakkho na ca vīkalo [napi paṅgulo (sī. pī.), na ca piṅgalo (syā.)];
segments.ja538:5.3: Adhammaṃ sārathi kayirā, maṃ ce tvaṃ nikhaṇaṃ vane”.
segments.ja538:6.1: “Ūrū bāhuṃ [bāhū (sī. ka.)] ca me passa, bhāsitañca suṇohi me;
segments.ja538:6.3: Adhammaṃ sārathi kayirā, maṃ ce tvaṃ nikhaṇaṃ vane”.
segments.ja538:7.1: “Devatā nusi gandhabbo, adu [ādu (sī.), ādū (syā.)] sakko purindado;
segments.ja538:7.3: Ko vā tvaṃ kassa vā putto, kathaṃ jānemu taṃ mayaṃ”.
segments.ja538:8.1: “Namhi devo na gandhabbo, nāpi sakko purindado;
segments.ja538:8.3: Kāsirañño ahaṃ putto, yaṃ kāsuyā nikhaññasi [nighaññasi (sī. pī.), nikhañchasi (?)].
segments.ja538:9.1: “Tassa rañño ahaṃ putto, yaṃ tvaṃ sammūpajīvasi [samupajīvasi (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja538:9.3: Adhammaṃ sārathi kayirā, maṃ ce tvaṃ nikhaṇaṃ vane.
segments.ja538:10.3: Na tassa sākhaṃ bhañjeyya, mittadubbho [mittadūbho (sī. pī.)] hi pāpako.
segments.ja538:11.1: “Yathā rukkho tathā rājā, yathā sākhā tathā ahaṃ;
segments.ja538:11.3: Yathā chāyūpago poso, evaṃ tvamasi sārathi;
segments.ja538:11.5: Adhammaṃ sārathi kayirā, maṃ ce tvaṃ nikhaṇaṃ vane.
segments.ja538:12.1: “Pahūtabhakkho [bahuttabhakkho (ka.)] bhavati, vippavuṭṭho [vippavuttho (sī. pī.), vippamutto (ka.)] sakaṃ [sakā (sī. pī.)] gharā;
segments.ja538:12.3: Bahū naṃ upajīvanti, yo mittānaṃ na dubbhati.
segments.ja538:13.3: Sabbattha pūjito hoti, yo mittānaṃ na dubbhati.
segments.ja538:14.1: “Nāssa corā pasāhanti [pasahanti (sī. syā. pī.)], nātimaññanti khattiyā [nātimaññeti khattiyo (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja538:14.3: Sabbe amitte tarati, yo mittānaṃ na dubbhati.
segments.ja538:15.1: “Akkuddho sagharaṃ eti, sabhāyaṃ [sabhāya (sī. syā. pī.)] paṭinandito;
segments.ja538:15.3: Ñātīnaṃ uttamo hoti, yo mittānaṃ na dubbhati.
segments.ja538:16.1: “Sakkatvā sakkato hoti, garu hoti sagāravo [garuko hoti gāravo (ka.)];
segments.ja538:16.3: Vaṇṇakittibhato hoti, yo mittānaṃ na dubbhati.
segments.ja538:17.3: Yaso kittiñca pappoti, yo mittānaṃ na dubbhati.
segments.ja538:18.3: Siriyā ajahito hoti, yo mittānaṃ na dubbhati.
segments.ja538:19.3: Vuttānaṃ phalamasnāti, yo mittānaṃ na dubbhati.
segments.ja538:20.3: Cuto patiṭṭhaṃ labhati, yo mittānaṃ na dubbhati.
segments.ja538:21.3: Amittā nappasāhanti, yo mittānaṃ na dubbhati”.
segments.ja538:22.3: Rajjaṃ kārehi bhaddante, kiṃ araññe karissasi”.
segments.ja538:23.1: “Alaṃ me tena rajjena, ñātakehi [ñātakena (syā. ka.)] dhanena vā;
segments.ja538:23.3: Yaṃ me adhammacariyāya, rajjaṃ labbhetha sārathi”.
segments.ja538:24.1: “Puṇṇapattaṃ maṃ lābhehi [palābhehi (sī. pī.)], rājaputta ito gato;
segments.ja538:24.3: Pitā mātā ca me dajjuṃ, rājaputta tayī gate.
segments.ja538:25.1: “Orodhā ca kumārā ca, vesiyānā ca brāhmaṇā;
segments.ja538:25.3: Tepi attamanā dajjuṃ, rājaputta tayī gate.
segments.ja538:26.3: Tepi attamanā dajjuṃ [tepi dajjuṃ patītāme (sī. pī.)], rājaputta tayī gate.
segments.ja538:27.1: “Bahudhaññā jānapadā [bahū jānapadā caññe (sī.), bahū janapadā caññe (pī.)], negamā ca samāgatā;
segments.ja538:27.3: Upāyanāni me dajjuṃ, rājaputta tayī gate”.
segments.ja538:28.1: “Pitu mātu cahaṃ catto, raṭṭhassa nigamassa ca;
segments.ja538:28.3: Atho sabbakumārānaṃ, natthi mayhaṃ sakaṃ gharaṃ.
segments.ja538:32.1: “Evaṃ vaggukatho santo, visaṭṭhavacano casi [ca so (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja538:32.3: Kasmā pitu ca mātucca, santike na bhaṇī tadā”.
segments.ja538:33.3: Nāhaṃ ajivhatā mūgo, mā maṃ mūgamadhārayi [mūgo adhārayi (sī.)].
segments.ja538:34.3: Kārayitvā tahiṃ rajjaṃ, pāpatthaṃ nirayaṃ bhusaṃ.
segments.ja538:36.1: “Tassa rajjassahaṃ bhīto, mā maṃ rajjābhisecayuṃ [rajjebhisecayuṃ (syā. ka.)];
segments.ja538:36.3: Tasmā pitu ca mātucca, santike na bhaṇiṃ tadā.
segments.ja538:37.3: Ekaṃ hanatha bandhatha, ekaṃ khārāpatacchikaṃ [kharāpaticchakaṃ (syā.), kharāpaṭicchakaṃ (ka.)];
segments.ja538:37.5: Ekaṃ sūlasmiṃ uppetha [appetha (sī.), ubbetha (syā.), accetha (pī.)], iccassa manusāsati.
segments.ja538:39.3: Komaṃ [ko taṃ (sī. pī.)] jīvitamāgamma, veraṃ kayirātha kenaci.
segments.ja538:40.3: Komaṃ [ko taṃ (sī. pī.)] jīvitamāgamma, veraṃ kayirātha kenaci.
segments.ja538:43.3: Avhāyassu [avhayassu (sī. pī.)] maṃ bhaddante, pabbajjā mama ruccati”.
segments.ja538:44.3: Anaṇassa hi pabbajjā, etaṃ isīhi vaṇṇitaṃ”.
segments.ja538:45.3: Tadeva me tvaṃ vacanaṃ, yācito kattumarahasi.
segments.ja538:46.3: Appeva te pitā disvā, patīto sumano siyā”.
segments.ja538:47.1: “Karomi tetaṃ vacanaṃ, yaṃ maṃ bhaṇasi sārathi;
segments.ja538:48.3: Mātaraṃ pitaraṃ mayhaṃ, vutto vajjāsi vandanaṃ”.
segments.ja538:49.1: Tassa pāde gahetvāna, katvā ca naṃ padakkhiṇaṃ;
segments.ja538:51.1: “Ayaṃ so sārathi eti, nihantvā mama atrajaṃ;
segments.ja538:51.3: Nihato nūna me putto, pathabyā bhūmivaḍḍhano.
segments.ja538:52.3: Āgataṃ sārathiṃ disvā, nihantvā mama atrajaṃ.
segments.ja538:53.3: Assupuṇṇehi nettehi, rodantī paripucchi naṃ [rodantī paripucchati (sī. pī.), rodantī naṃ paripucchati (syā.)].
segments.ja538:54.1: “Kinnu mūgo kiṃ nu pakkho, kinnu so vilapī tadā;
segments.ja538:54.3: Nihaññamāno bhūmiyā, taṃ me akkhāhi sārathi.
segments.ja538:55.3: Nihaññamāno bhūmiyā, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito”.
segments.ja538:56.1: “Akkheyyaṃ [akkhissaṃ (sī. pī.)] te ahaṃ ayye, dajjāsi abhayaṃ mama;
segments.ja538:56.3: Yaṃ me sutaṃ vā diṭṭhaṃ vā, rājaputtassa santike”.
segments.ja538:57.1: “Abhayaṃ samma te dammi, abhīto bhaṇa sārathi;
segments.ja538:57.3: Yaṃ te sutaṃ vā diṭṭhaṃ vā, rājaputtassa santike”.
segments.ja538:58.1: “Na so mūgo na so pakkho, visaṭṭhavacano ca so;
segments.ja538:58.3: Rajjassa kira so bhīto, akarā [akarī (sī. pī.)] ālaye bahū.
segments.ja538:59.3: Kārayitvā tahiṃ rajjaṃ, pāpattha nirayaṃ bhusaṃ.
segments.ja538:61.1: “Tassa rajjassa so bhīto, mā maṃ rajjābhisecayuṃ;
segments.ja538:61.3: Tasmā pitu ca mātucca, santike na bhaṇī tadā.
segments.ja538:63.3: Ehi taṃ pāpayissāmi, yattha sammati temiyo”.
segments.ja538:64.1: “Yojayantu rathe asse, kacchaṃ nāgāna [nāgāni (syā. ka.)] bandhatha;
segments.ja538:64.3: Udīrayantu saṅkhapaṇavā, vādantu [vadantu (sī.), nadantu (syā. ka.), vadataṃ (pī.)] ekapokkharā.
segments.ja538:65.1: “Vādantu [nadantu (sī. syā. pī.)] bherī sannaddhā, vaggū vādantu dundubhī;
segments.ja538:65.3: Negamā ca maṃ anventu, gacchaṃ puttanivedako [nivādako (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja538:66.1: “Orodhā ca kumārā ca, vesiyānā ca brāhmaṇā;
segments.ja538:66.3: Khippaṃ yānāni yojentu, gacchaṃ puttanivedako [nivādako (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja538:67.3: Khippaṃ yānāni yojentu, gacchaṃ puttanivedako [nivādako (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja538:68.3: Khippaṃ yānāni yojentu, gacchaṃ puttanivedako”[nivādako (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja538:69.3: Rājadvāraṃ upāgacchuṃ, yuttā deva ime hayā”.
segments.ja538:70.3: Kise thūle vivajjetvā, saṃsaṭṭhā yojitā hayā”.
segments.ja538:72.3: Upādhi rathamāruyha [upādirathamāruyha (sī.), upādhī rathamāruyha (syā.)], suvaṇṇehi alaṅkatā.
segments.ja538:73.1: “Tato sa [ca (sī. syā. pī.)] rājā pāyāsi, purakkhatvāna sārathiṃ;
segments.ja538:75.1: “Kacci nu tāta kusalaṃ, kacci tāta anāmayaṃ;
segments.ja538:75.3: Sabbā ca [kaccinnu (sī. pī.)] rājakaññāyo, arogā mayha mātaro”.
segments.ja538:76.3: Sabbā ca rājakaññāyo, arogā tuyha mātaro”.
segments.ja538:77.1: “Kacci amajjapo [kaccissa’ majjapo (sī. pī.)] tāta, kacci te suramappiyaṃ;
segments.ja538:77.3: Kacci sacce ca dhamme ca, dāne te ramate mano”.
segments.ja538:78.3: Atho sacce ca dhamme ca, dāne me ramate mano”.
segments.ja538:79.1: “Kacci arogaṃ yoggaṃ te, kacci vahati vāhanaṃ;
segments.ja538:80.1: “Atho arogaṃ yoggaṃ me, atho vahati vāhanaṃ;
segments.ja538:80.3: Atho me byādhayo natthi, sarīrassupatāpanā”[sarīrassupatāpiyā (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja538:81.1: “Kacci antā ca te phītā, majjhe ca bahalā tava;
segments.ja538:81.3: Koṭṭhāgārañca kosañca, kacci te paṭisanthataṃ”[paṭisaṇṭhitaṃ (syā. ka.)].
segments.ja538:82.1: “Atho antā ca me phītā, majjhe ca bahalā mama;
segments.ja538:83.3: Patiṭṭhapentu [patiṭṭhāpentu (sī. syā. pī.)] pallaṅkaṃ, yattha rājā nisakkati”.
segments.ja538:84.1: “Idheva te nisīdassu [nisinnassa (sī. syā. pī.), nisinnassu (ka.)], niyate paṇṇasanthare;
segments.ja538:84.3: Etto udakamādāya, pāde pakkhālayassu [pakkhālayantu (sī.), pakkhālayanti (pī.)] te”.
segments.ja538:86.1: “Na cāhaṃ [na vāhaṃ (ka.)] paṇṇaṃ bhuñjāmi, na hetaṃ mayha bhojanaṃ;
segments.ja538:88.3: Tāya me ekaseyyāya, rāja vaṇṇo pasīdati.
segments.ja538:89.1: “Na ca nettiṃsabandhā [nettisabaddhā (sī. pī.)] me, rājarakkhā upaṭṭhitā;
segments.ja538:89.3: Tāya me sukhaseyyāya, rāja vaṇṇo pasīdati.
segments.ja538:91.3: Etena bālā sussanti, naḷova harito luto”.
segments.ja538:92.3: Nivesanāni rammāni, ahaṃ putta dadāmi te.
segments.ja538:93.3: Tā putta paṭipajjassu [tāsu putte paṭipajja (ka.)], tvaṃ no rājā bhavissasi.
segments.ja538:94.3: Kāme taṃ ramayissanti, kiṃ araññe karissasi.
segments.ja538:95.3: Tāsu putte janetvāna, atha pacchā pabbajissasi.
segments.ja538:96.1: “Yuvā ca daharo cāsi [cāpi (syā. ka.)], paṭhamuppattiko [paṭhamuppattito (sī. pī.)] susu;
segments.ja538:96.3: Rajjaṃ kārehi bhaddante, kiṃ araññe karissasi”.
segments.ja538:97.3: Daharassa hi pabbajjā, etaṃ isīhi vaṇṇitaṃ.
segments.ja538:99.1: “Passāmi vohaṃ daharaṃ, amma tāta vadantaraṃ [vadaṃ naraṃ (sī.)];
segments.ja538:99.3: Kicchāladdhaṃ piyaṃ puttaṃ, appatvāva jaraṃ mataṃ.
segments.ja538:101.1: “Daharāpi hi miyyanti, narā ca atha nāriyo;
segments.ja538:101.3: Tattha ko vissase poso, daharomhīti jīvite.
segments.ja538:102.3: Appodakeva macchānaṃ, kiṃ nu komārakaṃ [komārataṃ (ka.)] tahiṃ.
segments.ja538:103.3: Amoghāsu vajantīsu, kiṃ maṃ rajjebhisiñcasi”[rajjena siñcasi (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja538:104.3: Kāyo amoghā gacchanti, taṃ me akkhāhi pucchito”.
segments.ja538:105.3: Ratyo amoghā gacchanti, evaṃ jānāhi khattiya.
segments.ja538:106.1: “Yathāpi tante vitate [vitante (syā. ka.)], yaṃ yadevūpaviyyati [yaṃ yaṃ devūpaviyyati (sī. pī.)];
segments.ja538:106.3: Appakaṃ hoti vetabbaṃ, evaṃ maccāna jīvitaṃ.
segments.ja538:107.1: “Yathā vārivaho pūro, gacchaṃ nupanivattati [na parivattati (syā.), nuparivattati (ka.)];
segments.ja538:109.3: Nivesanāni rammāni, ahaṃ putta dadāmi te.
segments.ja538:110.3: Tā putta paṭipajjassu, tvaṃ no rājā bhavissasi.
segments.ja538:111.3: Kāme taṃ ramayissanti, kiṃ araññe karissasi.
segments.ja538:112.3: Tāsu putte janetvāna, atha pacchā pabbajissasi.
segments.ja538:113.3: Rajjaṃ kārehi bhaddante, kiṃ araññe karissasi.
segments.ja538:114.3: Nivesanāni rammāni, ahaṃ putta dadāmi te.
segments.ja538:115.3: Rajjaṃ kārehi bhaddante, kiṃ araññe karissasi”.
segments.ja538:116.1: “Kiṃ dhanena yaṃ khīyetha [kiṃ dhanena yaṃ jīyetha (sī.), kiṃ maṃ dhanena kīyetha (syā. ka.)], kiṃ bhariyāya marissati;
segments.ja538:116.3: Kiṃ yobbanena jiṇṇena [ciṇṇena (sī. pī.), vaṇṇena (ka.)], yaṃ jarāyābhibhuyyati [yaṃ jarā abhihessati (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja538:117.1: “Tattha kā nandi kā khiḍḍā, kā rati kā dhanesanā;
segments.ja538:117.3: Kiṃ me puttehi dārehi, rāja muttosmi bandhanā.
segments.ja538:118.1: “Yohaṃ [sohaṃ (sī. pī.)] evaṃ pajānāmi, maccu me nappamajjati;
segments.ja538:119.3: Evaṃ jātāna maccānaṃ, niccaṃ maraṇato bhayaṃ.
segments.ja538:120.1: “Sāyameke na dissanti, pāto diṭṭhā bahū janā;
segments.ja538:120.3: Pāto eke na dissanti, sāyaṃ diṭṭhā bahū janā.
segments.ja538:121.1: “Ajjeva kiccaṃ ātappaṃ, ko jaññā maraṇaṃ suve;
segments.ja538:121.3: Na hi no saṅkaraṃ [saṅgaraṃ (sī. pī.) ma. ni.3.272] tena, mahāsenena maccunā.
segments.ja538:122.3: Ehi rāja nivattassu, nāhaṃ rajjena matthiko”ti.
